source_analysis: PDF coverage: LLM/inference/training, providers, prompt engineering, embeddings and vector databases, RAG, agents, multimodal AI, safety, and development tools. Expanded with APIs, permissions, eval datasets, tracing, privacy, threat modeling, reliability, and a deployed capstone.
analysis_method: Extracted labels from the one-page source PDF and visually reviewed the rendered roadmap layout; regrouped prerequisites into a sequential learning path and expanded topics for practical projects and production work.
learning_sequence: Follow stages and nodes in order. Optional specialization can be revisited after the capstone.

current_practice_note: Technology and hosted model/service names change quickly. Learn stable concepts, choose one implementation, verify versions and APIs in linked primary documentation, and note the date and tradeoffs in project work.
